title: Lincoln City
logline: 101 north through Lincoln City from a bus window he never sat at: outlet stores, a kite shop, the D River sign, the sea in the gaps. The page puts the town's clutter in and keeps the seat's reflection empty.

panels.composition: A bus window from inside: a strip of coastal town passing — a kite shop, an outlet mall's sign, a small bridge sign — with the sea gray in the gaps between buildings, the window reflecting an empty seat.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a bus window from inside showing a coastal town's roadside passing with a kite shop and a small bridge sign and gray sea in the gaps between buildings, the glass reflecting an empty seat, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: The clutter in; the seat empty.
